numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
key_facts: 8-month history of persistent swelling around the left eye
no history of significant acne vulgaris or rosacea
no visual symptoms
evaluated by an allergist and an ophthalmologist
no improvement with corticosteroid ophthalmic solutions or oral antihistamines

negative tuberculin skin test result
